_comment: Appearance augmentation of the image model's training renders (hairdeck.data.imgdata): p_style = probability of the style branch (style operations of hairdeck.data.style_ops at the render's native resolution, at least min_ops of them; colour = probabilities of the colour stage). The released image model was trained with these settings and, in addition, restyled renders mixed in with probability 0.33; p_style 0 trains with the base augmentation only.
